about: The MVP feature list, in build order. /factory next takes the first feature whose status is failing and that has no job yet. Only the /factory manager edits this file. A feature becomes passing only when the owner approves its job.

features.name: Stack & architecture
features.note: Also sets up the factory's missing infrastructure: GitHub checks, the Supabase test database (EU), and Cloudflare preview links.

features.name: Factory smoke test: a Hei! page that saves one visit
features.note: Proves every factory step works before real features. See the plan's 'Factory smoke test'.

features.name: Data model
features.note: Merged 20 October 2026. The 104 v2 sentences still wait for the reviewer's corrections list (statement 15).

features.name: Design system & UI foundation
features.note: Merged 21 October 2026: v2's look improved, flat sprout icon approved.

features.name: Content pipeline & native review
features.note: Merged 21 October 2026. Statement 18 (the reviewer's real approval and the unit 1 publish) moves to job 12. The first real keyed run happens after the merge.

features.name: Factory: pull-request browser tests against a throwaway local database
features.note: Decided by the owner on 20 October 2026: before job 6, so jobs that add tables can pass browser tests while database changes still reach the shared test project only after approval. Merged 21 October 2026. Option B (Docker Desktop for the evaluator) still to set up by the owner.

features.name: First session loop (Hear it, Understand it)
features.note: Merged 22 October 2026. Real content appears only after job 7 publishes a reviewer approved dialogue; the browser tests use a test fixture in a throwaway database.

features.name: Speaking feedback & voice consent (Say it)
features.note: Uses Azure pronunciation assessment provisionally. Test 3 runs after the MVP and may change the provider.

features.name: Accounts & personal data
features.note: Merged 29 October 2026. The privacy notice names Fumnanya Nketa with the contact address the owner gave; the address sits in one setting.

features.name: Units 1 to 3 content
features.note: Merged 29 October 2026. Six dialogues drafted with real providers. The native reviewer checks all six at the end of the MVP (statement 19), and the preview statement (8) waits for the Cloudflare preview keys.

features.name: Factory: private review site for the native reviewer at puhuscribe-review.exentrik.co
features.note: Owner decision 22 October 2026: review pages only, behind Cloudflare Access. Moved on 30 October 2026 from puhuscribe.exentrik.co to puhuscribe-review.exentrik.co, because the live learner app takes puhuscribe.exentrik.co. The reviewer's email is the owner's to give. Merged 22 October 2026 into the public repository. Stays failing until the first deploy and the live checks pass after the owner's Cloudflare setup in the Exentrik account.

features.name: Analytics, feedback and crash reporting, with PuhuScribe counting its own visitors by country
features.note: Owner decision 30 October 2026: the live app is at puhuscribe.exentrik.co; PuhuScribe counts its own visitors by country and day (Finland included) in its own EU database, with no third-party counter; Cloudflare Web Analytics switched off for exentrik.co.
